additions.reason: David is explicitly identified as bechina of chesed in Torah #283: 'דָּוִד דִּגְלֵי מַסֶּכְתָּא... זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד דְּאִתְפַּשַּׁט לְבַר.' David who revealed his masechet is the named human archetype of the chesed/outward-revealing quality. The bechina edge דוד ↔ חסד (or equivalently דוד ↔ מגלה תורתו לאחרים) is missing from the dataset for Torah #283. He belongs in Package 1.

additions.reason: The Zohar phrase 'טוֹב — טוּבֵהּ כְּלִיל בְּגַוֵּהּ' (goodness contained entirely within itself) is the explicit bechina of the inward-keeping tzaddik type. The Torah opens by saying the two tzaddikim are 'זֶה בְּחִינַת טוֹב' and 'זֶה בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד.' טוֹב as a conceptual pole (inward, self-contained goodness) is the mirror-opposite of חסד in Package 1. The bechina edge טוֹב ↔ [the non-revealing tzaddik] is missing. Polarity is neutral because טוֹב here is not evil — it is a legitimate tzaddik quality; the Torah frames both archetypes as valid. It belongs in a gap-package (Package 4 proposed) that mirrors Package 1.
additions.source_quote: זֶה בְּחִינַת טוֹב, שֶׁטּוּבֵהּ כְּלִיל בְּגַוֵּהּ, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְגַלֶּה תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים

additions.reason: Shaul is explicitly named as bechina of the inward-containing quality (טוֹב): 'שָׁאוּל דְּלָא גְּלֵי מַסֶּכְתָּא, זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת טוֹב, דְּטוּבֵהּ גְּנִיז בְּגַוֵּהּ.' The bechina שאול ↔ טוֹב is absent from the dataset for Torah #283. Shaul is the named human archetype of the inward-containing tzaddik, precisely mirroring David in Package 1. He belongs in the same package as טוֹב (Package 4).
additions.source_quote: שָׁאוּל דְּלָא גְּלֵי מַסֶּכְתָּא, זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת טוֹב, דְּטוּבֵהּ גְּנִיז בְּגַוֵּהּ

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly says the first tzaddik archetype (Shaul/Tov type) is defined by 'שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְגַלֶּה תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים' — not-revealing is the bechina-definition of the טוֹב quality. This directly mirrors 'מגלה תורתו לאחרים' which is in the dataset as bechina of חסד. The not-revealing action is a bechina of טוֹב, just as revealing is a bechina of חסד. The missing bechina edge is: אינו מגלה תורתו ↔ טוֹב. This belongs in Package 4.

additions.reason: The hot vapors (אֵדִים חַמִּים) are the physical analog of Torah-fire inside the inward tzaddik. The Torah describes them as part of the thunder mechanism: 'יוֹצְאִין אֵדִים חַמִּים כְּמוֹ אֵשׁ, וְהָעֲנָנִים שׁוֹאֲבִין אוֹתָן הָאֵדִים חַמִּים... נִבְקָע הֶעָנָן, וּמִזֶּה נַעֲשִׂין רְעָמִים.' The hot vapors are an intermediate structural bechina between Torah-fire (Package 2) and thunder/dispute (Package 3). While no explicit 'בחינת' language is used for them directly, they are the named mechanism that makes רעמים structurally identical to the compressed Torah — placing them within the dispute/thunder domain (Package 3) as a sub-metaphor.
additions.source_quote: יוֹצְאִין אֵדִים חַמִּים כְּמוֹ אֵשׁ, וְהָעֲנָנִים שׁוֹאֲבִין אוֹתָן הָאֵדִים חַמִּים, וּמֵחֲמַת שֶׁשּׁוֹאֲבִין אוֹתָם הָאֵדִים הַרְבֵּה עַד שֶׁאֵין יְכוֹלִין לְהַחֲזִיקָם בְּתוֹכָם, עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִבְקָע הֶעָנָן, וּמִזֶּה נַעֲשִׂין רְעָמִים
